a: An `onPath` constraint survives a subpath reversal with its segment still named in the old direction, so the solve holds the anchor on the wrong curve
`segmentBetween` cannot answer the closing segment of a two-anchor closed subpath, and answers its opening segment instead
A path's own constraint naming an anchor past that path's count silently binds an anchor of the next path in a multi-path edit
A `length` or `equalLength` constraint whose segment starts with zero length gets no gradient, so the solve cannot open the segment
b: anchorsBefore takes an anchor the edit added at an open subpath's end for a copy of its neighbor, so constraints and `fixed` references move onto the new anchor
An item's own constraint naming an anchor past its path's count binds to another item's anchor in constrainPathsEdit
